Our team is shaping the future of agentic AI systems for cybersecurity solutions in the automotive industry. By combining deep expertise in embedded systems and vehicle E/E architectures with state-of-the-art AI technologies, we develop automated approaches for identifying vulnerabilities in software and vehicle systems while continuously advancing security analysis capabilities.

What awaits you?

- You develop and maintain an agentic AI toolchain for the automated identification and assessment of vulnerabilities in software and vehicle systems.
- You design automated methods for detecting vulnerabilities in source code, binary code, and vehicle functionalities using both commercial and open-source AI models.
- By expanding AI-powered analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing workflows, you continuously enhance the effectiveness of security assessment capabilities.
- You integrate new analysis methods, models, and AI agents into the existing toolchain in a targeted and scalable manner.
- Through the design of intuitive user interfaces, you enable both security experts and software engineers to easily leverage the capabilities of the toolchain.
- In addition, you implement closed-loop feedback and learning mechanisms to continuously improve future analysis cycles and overall toolchain performance.

What should you bring along?

- University degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable qualification.
- Several years of professional experience in Automotive Cybersecurity.
- Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining agentic AI toolchains using both commercial and open-source technologies.
- Experience in developing or operating complex security toolchains.
- Business-fluent English language skills; German language skills are desirable.

Are you passionate about advancing agentic AI systems for automated vulnerability assessments and actively shaping the cybersecurity of future vehicle generations? Apply now!

Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.

European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.

The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.

The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.

Key purpose  

- Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.
- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.
- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.
- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.
- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.

Structure and reporting relationship 

The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  

Internal Communications

- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.
- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.
- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.
- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  

External Communications

- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.
- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.
- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.
- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.

Integration Communications

- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.
- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.

Social Media & Content Creation

- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.
- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.
- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.

Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.
- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.
- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.
- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.
- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.
- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.
- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.
- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.

Additional / special features of the role 

- Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.
- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.
- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.
- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.
- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.
- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration Europe

Desirable

- Must: German native or fully proficient
- Must: English level B2
- Desirable: French
- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.

jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.

AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs
- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity
- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management
- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites

2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover
- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs
- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs
- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics
- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs
- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case

3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)

- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings
- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines
- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families
- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio

4. NPI & Industrialization

- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production
- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects
- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program
- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)
- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans
- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)
- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp
- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance
- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection

6. Financial & Resource Management

- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio
- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control
- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs
- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility
- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates

7. Transformation & Change Leadership

- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability
- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)
- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture
- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery

8. Governance, Risk & Compliance

- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements
- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs
- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigation

Your Profile

Professional Experience

- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization
- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions
- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)
- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout
- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance
- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability
- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control
- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)
- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures
- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)

Intercultural Experience

- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies
- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures
- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level
- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisite

Personal attributes

- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus
- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs
- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)
- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management
- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity
- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure
- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes
- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates
- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups
- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions
- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments
- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talent

(Senior) Research Associate - Protein Science (gn)
Antibody Discovery & Development · Martinsried / Munich · Full-time

About us
iOmx Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company in the field of immuno-oncology, located in Martinsried/Munich, Germany. We are focused on the development of novel biomarker-supported cancer immunotherapies and are propagating an evolving pipeline of powerful multifunctional antibodies and T cell engagers. We are looking for highly motivated, self-driven and competent colleagues who share our vision and want to help turn it into reality. As part of our Protein Science team within the Antibody Discovery and Development Department, you will focus on the expression of recombinant proteins, antibodies and multispecific molecules in mammalian expression systems. You will advance the development of our transient expression platform, driving the discovery and development of innovative large-molecule biopharmaceuticals. Your responsibilities will include:

Plan and execute transient transfections in HEK and CHO - at various research scales
Develop and optimize our transient expression platforms: process, scale-up, yield, and quality
Run the molecular biology behind it: cloning and plasmid DNA prep at transfection scale
Contribute to construct design and feasibility assessment
Step in as dedicated backup for protein purification and downstream processing
Support analytics: characterization of recombinant proteins using state-of-the-art biochemical and biophysical methods (SDS-PAGE, LAL assay, HPLC)
Take responsibility for protein science lab equipment and infrastructure
Carefully evaluate, interpret, and document results in electronic lab journals and databases
Present data in internal meetings
You are the ideal candidate for this position if you bring the following:

You hold a vocational qualification as CTA, BTA, MTA or an equivalent university degree in a relevant field; at least 4 years of professional laboratory experience is preferred
You have in-depth experience in mammalian cell culture and transient transfection (HEK, CHO)
You have solid experience in cloning and molecular biology techniques; experience in construct design is a plus
You consider downstream processing and adjacent analytical methods as a welcome variety of your daily business
You pay attention to detail in experimental execution and documentation and have solid knowledge of relevant lab techniques and equipment, as well as standard laboratory and MS Office software

jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 November 2026:

Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)

in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals** (m/f/d)**

(Full time / part time** **options available)

﻿

Location: Frankfurt am Main
Employment scope: Full-time; part time options are available
Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 years
Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.

There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.

Your tasks

- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses
- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches
- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling
- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses
- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party funding

Your profile

- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field
- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.
- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage
- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R
- Very good written and oral communication skills in English
- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigenetics

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, gender, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application as a single PDF by 5 October 2026, including:

- CV
- Letter of motivation
- Academic transcripts and certificates/credentials
- Two relevant publications
- Contact details of two potential references

Please compress the files where possible. If the two publications cause the file to exceed the upload limit, they may be uploaded separately.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Axel Janke ataxel.janke@senckenberg.de

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/

Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

The position is embedded in EU-MIC (European Coalition for Mental Health Medicines Innovation), a strategic initiative led by the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology (ECNP). EU-MIC aims to address the growing innovation gap in psychopharmacology between Europe and the United States and to examine the structural disparities between mental and somatic health in access to innovative medicines.

A major workstream of the project focuses on the quantification of the direct and indirect societal costs of mental disorders, including:

- healthcare and treatment costs
- sick leave, retirement and disability-related costs
- productivity losses
- presenteeism and absenteeism
- broader social and long-term economic consequences

The resulting evidence will contribute to scientific publications, European policy reports, and advocacy activities targeting regulators, HTA bodies, payers, policymakers, clinicians, patients, and carers.

The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extending it to three years. There is also the opportunity to pursue a habilitation.

Your Role:

- Develop and implement a health-economic data analysis plan within EU-MIC
- Identify, collate, harmonise, and analyse national and international datasets (which, in part, will also be delivered by the supporting companies) and evidence sources
- Model direct and indirect costs of mental disorders across European healthcare systems
- Quantify presenteeism, productivity losses, and wider societal economic impacts
- Conduct systematic evidence reviews, evidence synthesis, and health-economic modelling
- Establish transparent data structures, metadata standards, and reproducible analytical workflows
- Prepare peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, policy briefs, and stakeholder presentations

Your Responsibilities:

- End-to-end responsibility for strategic global category purchasing, including supplier selection, negotiations, and contracting
- Preparation, execution, and finalization of international negotiations and project-based sourcing activities for Production Equipment with a strong focus on value creation (e.g. TCO)
- Drive cost optimization, bundling effects, make-or-buy decisions, and value engineering initiatives
- Manage supplier performance, claims, and escalations with strategic relevance
- Own the contract lifecycle and ensure compliance with internal policies and guidelines
- Develop and implement category and sourcing strategies, translating them into clear actions, KPIs, and measurable results
- Advise and collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure transparency and satisfaction
- Use data analytics and digital procurement tools to improve efficiency and decision-making
- Lead cross-functional and global purchasing projects for plant-related equipment and related services

Qualifications

- University degree (Bachelor/Master/Diploma) or comparable qualification
- Several years of relevant professional experience in strategic purchasing, category management, or project-based sourcing
- Proven experience in CAPEX procurement is required; experience in technical purchasing and project-based sourcing is essential for this role
- Strong analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
- Strong digital and AI affinity, with the ability to leverage modern digital tools and AI to improve sourcing, supplier management, data analysis and processes
- Structured, independent, and results-oriented working style
- Excellent English and German skills (written and verbal); additional language skills are an advantage
